name: Sensible is now SOC 2 Type II certified
post-body:
At Sensible, we are committed to the security and privacy of the data that you entrust us with. Our SOC 2 Type II certification is a publicly visible milestone in the journey towards that commitment.
‍

‍
{{card-cta}}

‍

An independent auditor conducted an audit of our servers, systems, and processes verifying that our information security practices, policies, procedures, and operations meet the rigorous SOC 2 standards.

There are two types of SOC 2 reports - Type I and Type II. While the Type I report describes a service provider’s systems and whether the system is suitably designed to meet the set standards, the Type II report details the operational effectiveness of those systems and how effectively our internal controls and processes operate over a period of time. Just as important as building a secure and private system is the ability to live those principles of security every day as you operate and further develop the system.

‍

{{inline-cta}}

‍

Security and privacy is an ongoing and key investment for Sensible. If you are interested in seeing a copy of our SOC 2 Type II certification report, contact your Sensible representative or reach out to support@sensible.so.
